s1.syndrome_frame: Progressively enlarging, painless, ulcerated skin lesions with central crusting in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Painless nodular lesions on the forehead and right cheek
Arborizing telangiectasias and peripheral pigment on dermoscopy
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
Lesions were initially observed as erythematous nodules 3 months prior
Lesions gradually increased in size
No fever, pain, or discharge from the lesions
Patient has a history of kidney transplant in 2004
Patient is immunocompromised
Lesions are firm with central ulceration and hemorrhagic crusting
Dermoscopy showed arborizing telangiectasias, central ulceration with crusting, and peripheral pigment
Histopathological examination showed extensive dermal collection of lymphocytes, histiocytes, and macrophages
Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos were identified on histopathological examination

differentials: Cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania braziliensis
per_call: Cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania braziliensis

shortlist.label: Cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with progressively enlarging, painless, ulcerated skin lesions and histopathological evidence of intracellular yeasts

shortlist.label: Blastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation and histopathological findings, including intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and histopathological findings consistent with this fungal infection, which can affect immunocompromised individuals

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with skin lesions, although the presence of intracellular yeasts is not typical for this condition

shortlist.label: Cutaneous lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with skin lesions, and lymphoma can present with a wide range of skin manifestations

raw.rationale: The presence of intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos on histopathological examination is characteristic of Cryptococcosis, particularly in an immunocompromised patient.

rejected.label: Blastomycosis
rejected.why: While Blastomycosis can present with similar skin lesions, the histopathological findings do not match, as Blastomycosis typically shows broad-based budding yeasts.

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: Histoplasmosis usually presents with smaller intracellular yeasts without halos, and the clinical presentation does not typically include the described skin lesions.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Kaposi's sarcoma is a type of cancer that can present with skin lesions in immunocompromised patients, but the histopathological findings and dermoscopy results do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous lymphoma
rejected.why: Cutaneous lymphoma can present with a variety of skin lesions, but the histopathological findings of intracellular yeasts with halos are not consistent with this diagnosis.
